parole.significato: dockyard, especially the Ottoman Imperial Arsenal at Constantinople
parole.testo: From Ottoman Turkish ترسانه (tersane), from Ligurian tersaná, from Arabic دَار اَلصِّنَاعَة (dār aṣ-ṣināʕa, “industry house”).
